title: All-order prescription for facet regions in massless wide-angle scattering
summary: We take a step toward answering a long-standing question in the asymptotic expansion of Feynman integrals: how to systematically determine and interpret the regions in the Expansion-by-Regions technique for multiscale processes? Focusing on generic massless wide-angle scattering, we provide an all-order momentum-space prescription for facet regions, which generally dominate -- and in most cases exhaust -- the contributions in a given asymptotic expansion.
